description: Core-seeded defensive guard atoms anchored on std/core.mm safety primitives (safe_to_index, is_nonzero, checked_add). Each atom provides a structural predicate or bounded-safe operation useful for downstream container/math modules. All bodies are explicit linear integer constraints with 0/1 witnesses, remaining entirely within the Z3 decidable fragment.
implementation_notes: Each atom has an explicit body so deterministic forge rendering never needs an LLM credential.
Use only linear integer constraints and 0/1 witnesses.
Anchor the contracts on std/core.mm concepts such as safe_to_index, is_nonzero, and checked_sub without importing new trusted atoms.

atoms.name: is_in_bounds
atoms.description: Return a 0/1 witness for whether val is inside the inclusive range [lo, hi].
atoms.body: if val >= lo { if val <= hi { 1 } else { 0 } } else { 0 }

atoms.name: safe_abs_diff
atoms.description: Compute the absolute difference of two non-negative integers, guaranteed non-negative.
atoms.body: if a >= b { a - b } else { b - a }

atoms.name: clamp_to_positive
atoms.description: Clamp a value to at least 1, useful for division denominators and loop bounds.

atoms.name: both_positive
atoms.description: Return a 0/1 witness for whether both inputs are strictly positive.
atoms.body: if a >= 1 { if b >= 1 { 1 } else { 0 } } else { 0 }
